text.arabic_uthmani: ثُمَّ جَعَلْنَٰكَ عَلَىٰ شَرِيعَةٍۢ مِّنَ ٱلْأَمْرِ فَٱتَّبِعْهَا وَلَا تَتَّبِعْ أَهْوَآءَ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ

words.gloss_range: sequential and rank-marking discourse particle opening a new appointment stage

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the completed placement verb opened by the particle
the path named in the placement clause

words.prose: {{ar:ثُمَّ}} ({{tr:thumma}}) does not merely continue the sentence; it stages a turn after the previous dispute into direct appointment. The particle opens the completed placement of the addressee in {{ar:جَعَلْنَٰكَ}} ({{tr:jaʿalnāka}}) and makes the following path-language in {{ar:شَرِيعَةٍۢ}} ({{tr:sharīʿatin}}) feel like the next raised phase of the argument. Its small sound can still carry weight: the ayah begins with a pause-like hinge before command replaces third-person diagnosis.

topics.headline: staged transition into appointment
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah begins as a staged turn from prior communal dispute into direct appointment.
topics.reason: QAC marks the word as a sequence conjunction/adverb, and the clause evidence shows it opening the placement clause.

topics.headline: ranked pivot toward command
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears sequence as also rhetorical elevation: the discourse moves upward into appointment, then into command.
topics.reason: The particle can carry sequence and discourse-ranking pressure, and the local ayah turns from diagnosis to a three-beat command structure.

topics.headline: weighted opening sound
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the opening particle as a compact pause before appointment rather than a throwaway connector.
topics.reason: The sound row concerns the surface form of this same particle and coheres with its boundary function.

words.gloss_range: completed divine making, placing, or appointing of the addressee into a normative relation
words.root_gloss_range: broad making, placing, assigning, appointing, and sometimes self-making family; the local frame selects divine appointment into position

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the upon-path complement governed by the placement verb
the consequent command that follows the completed placement

words.prose: {{ar:جَعَلْنَٰكَ}} ({{tr:jaʿalnāka}}) compresses divine agency and the addressed object into one completed act: the addressee is already placed before the command arrives. The complement {{ar:عَلَىٰ شَرِيعَةٍۢ}} ({{tr:ʿalā sharīʿatin}}) narrows the broad making-root into appointment onto a normative path, so the later {{ar:ٱتَّبِعْهَا}} ({{tr:ittabiʿhā}}) is obedience after assigned position, not self-started choice. The wider family can include self-making language, but this surface makes the route received from the divine speaker. That appointment pressure also lets the word converse with role-making language (2:30) and with the same-surah reversal where desire leads to covered perception (45:23).

topics.headline: completed divine agency before command
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that obligation follows a completed divine act rather than creating its own authority.
topics.reason: The verb is perfect active with first-person plural subject agreement and a second-person object suffix.

topics.headline: object placed into a norm
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the addressee not merely informed but assigned into a relation with the path.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks the suffix as object and the upon-path phrase as the complement of the same placement verb.

topics.headline: making range narrowed to appointment
topics.reader_payoff: The reader keeps the make-place-appoint range while seeing that the local complement selects appointment into a juridical path.
topics.reason: The root range is broad, but the local object plus upon-path complement selects role-assignment and placement rather than generic creation.

topics.headline: not self-fabricated path
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the path is not self-assumed by the addressee but assigned by the divine speaker.
topics.reason: The derivational contrast is useful as pressure, while the local surface is the divine first-person plural verb, not a self-making form.

topics.headline: agency and addressee compressed
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears divine agency and addressed obligation compressed into one word before the path is named.
topics.reason: The surface combines the first-person plural subject marker and second-person object suffix in one form.

topics.headline: appointment contrasted across references
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can connect this appointment to role-making language (2:30) and to the same-surah contrast where desire leads to covered perception (45:23).
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows supply concrete parallels; they illuminate appointment pressure without changing the local parse.

topics.headline: divine act precedes path naming
topics.reader_payoff: The reader receives the path inside a prior act of placement, not as an autonomous option.
topics.reason: The word order places the completed divine act before the path phrase and before the command.

words.gloss_range: upon-preposition marking footing, orientation, and binding norm in the placement frame

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the placement verb that governs the prepositional complement
the governed path noun

words.prose: {{ar:عَلَىٰ}} ({{tr:ʿalā}}) turns the placement in {{ar:جَعَلْنَٰكَ}} ({{tr:jaʿalnāka}}) into footing: the addressee is set upon {{ar:شَرِيعَةٍۢ}} ({{tr:sharīʿatin}}), not merely handed a detached rule. Its ordinary upon-sense and obligation-pressure meet here, so path imagery becomes a binding stance. The long final vowel lets the small preposition hold the bridge between placement and path.

topics.headline: path as assigned footing
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the path is the footing of the appointment rather than a detachable object.
topics.reason: The preposition governs the path noun as complement of the placement verb.

topics.headline: uponness becomes obligation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the spatial image of being upon a path turn into normative responsibility.
topics.reason: The local placement frame licenses both spatial footing and binding obligation pressure.

topics.headline: sustained prepositional bridge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the preposition as a held relation between the verb and the path.
topics.reason: The sound note is tied to the same prepositional bridge established by grammar.

words.gloss_range: one particular authorized path-law, opened for following and sourced from the command-domain
words.root_gloss_range: opening, beginning, prescribing, path-making, and water-road imagery; the local noun selects a followable path-law while preserving route-to-life pressure

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the preposition that makes the noun assigned footing
the source phrase qualifying the path
the command whose suffix resumes this noun
the plural rival object contrasted with the singular path

words.prose: {{ar:شَرِيعَةٍۢ}} ({{tr:sharīʿatin}}) is the ayah's named route: singular, placed under {{ar:عَلَىٰ}} ({{tr:ʿalā}}), qualified by {{ar:مِّنَ ٱلْأَمْرِ}} ({{tr:mina l-ʾamri}}), and then resumed by the suffix in {{ar:ٱتَّبِعْهَا}} ({{tr:ittabiʿhā}}). The law sense is local, but the root's opened-way and water-road pressure makes law feel like a life-directed route to be followed. Its singularity matters because it later faces {{ar:أَهْوَآءَ}} ({{tr:ahwāʾa}}), many dispersed pulls rather than one sourced path. The word is also rare and acoustically marked at the ayah's center, with a route-law counterpart in 5:48 rather than routine legal vocabulary.

topics.headline: path as governed footing and resumed object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees this noun control both the placement scene and the central follow-command.
topics.reason: The noun is governed by the upon-preposition and is resumed by the feminine suffix on the following imperative.

topics.headline: particular path from known authority
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a particular path introduced first, then anchored in the known authority-domain.
topics.reason: The noun is indefinite, while the following source noun is definite and governed by the source phrase.

topics.headline: law as opened life-route
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels law here as a followable opened route, with water-road imagery adding life-direction without replacing the legal sense.
topics.reason: The command to follow selects the path-law sense; root and lexical evidence preserve opening and water-road pressure as image, not as a separate local object.

topics.headline: one sourced path against many desires
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the morphology itself set one authorized route against many rival impulses.
topics.reason: The singular noun is contrasted locally with the later broken plural direct object of the prohibition.

topics.headline: rare route-law word carries distributional weight
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that this is not routine legal vocabulary; the rare route-law word carries marked weight and has a route counterpart in 5:48.
topics.reason: The rows supply rarity and the concrete related occurrence in 5:48, while the local ayah individualizes the route as the command object.

topics.headline: rare route word made audible
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can hear the rare route-word stand out at the ayah's center.
topics.reason: The sound row is local to the same noun and supports its marked centrality.

words.gloss_range: source, partitive, or explanatory preposition tying the path to the authority-domain

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the path qualified by the source particle
the authority-domain introduced by the particle

words.prose: {{ar:مِّنَ}} ({{tr:mina}}) prevents the path from floating free: it ties {{ar:شَرِيعَةٍۢ}} ({{tr:sharīʿatin}}) to {{ar:ٱلْأَمْرِ}} ({{tr:al-ʾamri}}) as source, specification, and authority-domain. The path is heard first, then this particle makes the listener wait for what authorizes it, resuming the same authority-domain named just before the ayah boundary (45:17). Its nasal contact gives the source relation a small but audible binding force.

topics.headline: path tied to authority-source
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the path is qualified by its source rather than by social preference.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks the following authority noun as the prepositional complement qualifying the path noun.

topics.headline: authority revealed after the path
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the route named first and then anchored in the same authority-domain resumed from the previous ayah.
topics.reason: The source particle comes after the path and before the authority noun, and the boundary row ties the phrase to ayah 17.

topics.headline: source relation made audible
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the small source particle bind path and authority rather than disappear as a thin connector.
topics.reason: The sound rows concern the particle's own nasal surface and liaison into the authority noun.

words.gloss_range: definite authority-domain: command, order, decree, and governing matter from which the path issues
words.root_gloss_range: commanding, ordering, affair, decree, governance, and acting under command; the local noun names the source-domain of the path

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the path sourced from this authority-domain
the preposition governing this source noun
the command and prohibition that follow the authority noun

words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْأَمْرِ}} ({{tr:al-ʾamri}}) closes the first beat on a definite authority-domain. Through {{ar:مِّنَ}} ({{tr:mina}}), {{ar:شَرِيعَةٍۢ}} ({{tr:sharīʿatin}}) is not just a route but a route issuing from command, order, and governing matter. The same command-domain has already framed natural governance and prior proof-language in the surah (45:12; 45:17), and here its crisp surface lands as the source of the path. That ending prepares {{ar:ٱتَّبِعْهَا وَلَا تَتَّبِعْ}} ({{tr:ittabiʿhā wa-lā tattabiʿ}}): the noun of authority turns immediately into commanded action and prohibited counter-action.

topics.headline: definite authority anchors the path
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that an indefinite path is grounded in a definite authority-domain.
topics.reason: The noun is definite, genitive after the source preposition, and syntactically tied to the path noun.

topics.headline: command and affair held together
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the path as both ordered command and part of the larger divine matter, not mere advice.
topics.reason: The local source phrase allows command, order, affair, and governing matter to operate together as the source-domain.

topics.headline: same-surah authority thread
topics.reader_payoff: The reader connects this source-domain to the surah's earlier command-language, including natural governance in 45:12 and prior proof-language in 45:17.
topics.reason: The rows give concrete same-surah references; they thread authority from governance and proofs into the source of this path.

topics.headline: source closes into command
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the authority noun become the springboard for the following imperative and prohibition.
topics.reason: The source noun closes the placement clause immediately before the consequent command and coordinated prohibition.

topics.headline: authority word crisply bounded
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the authority-domain as sharply marked at the end of the first beat.
topics.reason: The sound rows concern the article-hamza surface and its crisp onset within the local word.

words.gloss_range: consequential and immediate connector binding the command to the completed placement

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the imperative entered through the consequence particle
the fused consequence-command unit

words.prose: {{ar:فَ}} ({{tr:fa}}) makes the command a consequence of the placement, not a detached instruction. As soon as the path is sourced, the recitation moves into {{ar:ٱتَّبِعْهَا}} ({{tr:ittabiʿhā}}); relation and action are analytically distinct but heard together as {{ar:فَٱتَّبِعْهَا}} ({{tr:fa-ttabiʿhā}}). The particle compresses appointment into immediate obligation.

topics.headline: imperative as consequence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that following is the logical next act after being placed on the path.
topics.reason: The particle links the imperative clause to the completed placement clause as consequence and immediate sequence.

topics.headline: consequence fused to command
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the consequence relation flow directly into the act of following.
topics.reason: The particle is a separate segment but is visibly and audibly fused to the following imperative.

words.gloss_range: direct singular imperative to adoptively follow the path resumed by the feminine suffix
words.root_gloss_range: following, tracking, attachment, dependence, and allegiance; the local Form VIII imperative selects deliberate adherence to the path

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the feminine antecedent resumed by the suffix
the consequence particle scoping the imperative
the repeated following-root in the later prohibition
the rival object named after the prohibited following verb

words.prose: {{ar:ٱتَّبِعْهَا}} ({{tr:ittabiʿhā}}) is the ayah's compact pivot: under {{ar:فَ}} ({{tr:fa}}), the placed addressee is told to follow the path already named as {{ar:شَرِيعَةٍۢ}} ({{tr:sharīʿatin}}). The suffix keeps the object decisive, so the command is not generic piety but adherence to that sourced path. Its brief, geminated surface gives the central command audible pressure and immediacy. The root's tracking and dependence pressure becomes crucial when {{ar:تَتَّبِعْ}} ({{tr:tattabiʿ}}) repeats the same following action toward {{ar:أَهْوَآءَ}} ({{tr:ahwāʾa}}); the issue is which object wins allegiance.

topics.headline: consequent direct imperative
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the command as the direct consequence and structural hinge of the ayah.
topics.reason: The verb is a second-person masculine singular imperative in the clause linked by the consequence particle.

topics.headline: suffix locks the command to the path
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that the command follows the path, not the broader authority-domain as an undifferentiated object.
topics.reason: The feminine object suffix is strongly resolved to the path noun by attachment and referent evidence.

topics.headline: tracking becomes adopted adherence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels obedience as deliberate tracking of a path, not casual motion behind something.
topics.reason: The root gives following and tracking pressure, while Form VIII and the imperative select adopted adherence to the named object.

topics.headline: same following root, opposite objects
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that following itself is not neutral; its value turns on whether the object is path or desires.
topics.reason: The same root and near form recur in the coordinated prohibition, with a different object and polarity.

topics.headline: compressed command cadence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears pressure and immediacy in the brief central command.
topics.reason: The sound rows are local to the command's surface and its liaison with the preceding consequence particle.

words.gloss_range: coordinating connector that attaches the prohibition to the positive command as a linked contrast

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the positive command coordinated with the prohibition
the prohibition introduced through the connector
the prohibited rival object

words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) binds refusal to the command itself. The ayah does not say {{ar:ٱتَّبِعْهَا}} ({{tr:ittabiʿhā}}) and then start a separate moral note; {{ar:لَا تَتَّبِعْ}} ({{tr:lā tattabiʿ}}) is coordinated as the boundary of that obedience. In sound and syntax, rejecting {{ar:أَهْوَآءَ}} ({{tr:ahwāʾa}}) belongs to following the path.

topics.headline: prohibition attached to positive command
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that refusal of desire-following is part of following the path, not a separate ethic.
topics.reason: The conjunction coordinates the prohibition with the positive imperative.

topics.headline: linked but contrastive continuation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the next clause as connected contrast rather than a hard restart.
topics.reason: The connector can coordinate while the fused negation surface makes the contrast audible.

words.gloss_range: prohibitive negation governing the following jussive verb and blocking rival following

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the jussive verb governed by the prohibitive particle
the later descriptive negation that explains the rival group

words.prose: This first {{ar:لَا}} ({{tr:lā}}) is prohibitive, not descriptive. It governs {{ar:تَتَّبِعْ}} ({{tr:tattabiʿ}}) and blocks the rival act before the object is even named, so the ayah first establishes legitimate following and then bars counterfeit allegiance. Its echo with the later {{ar:لَا}} ({{tr:lā}}) creates a two-step negative frame: command-law first, epistemic diagnosis later.

topics.headline: negation as prohibition
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that this particle forbids an action rather than merely describing absence.
topics.reason: QAC and translation support mark the particle as prohibitive/jussive before the following verb.

topics.headline: proper object fixed before rival blocked
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the prohibition as limiting allegiance to the path already resumed by the positive command.
topics.reason: The negative clause follows the complete positive command and governs the verb whose object is desires.

topics.headline: two negations split law and diagnosis
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the repeated negation move from forbidding the act to explaining the ignorance behind it.
topics.reason: The first negation is prohibitive, while the later negation belongs to the relative predicate.

words.gloss_range: jussive second-person Form VIII following verb: a barred act of adopted adherence to desires
words.root_gloss_range: following, tracking, attachment, dependence, and allegiance; the local prohibitive frame makes rival desire-following the blocked branch

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the positive following command paired with this prohibited verb
the prohibitive particle governing this verb
the direct object of the prohibited following

words.prose: {{ar:تَتَّبِعْ}} ({{tr:tattabiʿ}}) repeats the following-root of {{ar:ٱتَّبِعْهَا}} ({{tr:ittabiʿhā}}) but under {{ar:لَا}} ({{tr:lā}}) and with {{ar:أَهْوَآءَ}} ({{tr:ahwāʾa}}) as object. That makes desire not a passing feeling but a trackable course that could claim allegiance, matching the wider warning against following desire without guidance (28:50) while this ayah supplies the positive route-object. The jussive stopping force and same Form VIII pattern sharpen the contrast: deliberate adherence is right when tied to the sourced path and forbidden when tied to desires.

topics.headline: rival following grammatically barred
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices desire-following as a real possible act that grammar blocks.
topics.reason: The verb is a second-person jussive/imperfect under prohibitive negation and takes desires as direct object.

topics.headline: desire treated as a false path
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees desires made path-like by the following verb, which is why they must be refused.
topics.reason: The following verb acts on desires as its object, treating them as something one could track or obey.

topics.headline: same Form VIII, opposite value
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the repeated form makes the object, not the act of following by itself, decide value.
topics.reason: Both following verbs are Form VIII-like in local analysis and coordinated as command/prohibition counterparts.

topics.headline: desire-following warning field
topics.reader_payoff: The reader connects the local prohibition to the wider warning against following desire without guidance, including 28:50 and the route-language contrast of 5:48.
topics.reason: The rows provide concrete cross-passage references and localize that warning in this direct prohibition.

topics.headline: sound presses and stops the barred action
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears pressure in the rival following and a stop under prohibition.
topics.reason: The sound rows are local to the jussive prohibited verb.

words.gloss_range: plural desires, inclinations, or whims treated as a forbidden guide-object and tied to owners without knowledge
words.root_gloss_range: desire, inclination, whim, falling, plunging, and being enticed; the local noun selects desires while preserving downward-pull pressure

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the prohibited following verb that takes this noun as object
the singular path contrasted with the plural desires
the relative clause identifying the desire-owners

words.prose: {{ar:أَهْوَآءَ}} ({{tr:ahwāʾa}}) is the rival object of {{ar:تَتَّبِعْ}} ({{tr:tattabiʿ}}): desires become something one might track, obey, or take as route. The broken plural scatters the object against the one {{ar:شَرِيعَةٍۢ}} ({{tr:sharīʿatin}}), and the root's falling-desire pressure makes that multiplicity feel downward, not neutral. The following {{ar:ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ}} ({{tr:alladhīna lā yaʿlamūn}}) then locates those desires socially and epistemically, while 45:23 later exposes the same desire-field as a singular false authority.

topics.headline: desires as prohibited object of following
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices desire not as private feeling only, but as a guide-object one could obey.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks the plural noun as the direct object of the prohibited following verb.

topics.headline: desire heard as downward pull
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels following desires as descent away from the placed path, while the local noun still means desires and inclinations.
topics.reason: The local sense is desires or inclinations, but root-family evidence and the following verb preserve falling and enticement pressure.

topics.headline: many pulls against one route
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees rival guidance represented as dispersed plural pulls rather than one authorized path.
topics.reason: The broken plural object stands in local contrast with the earlier singular path noun.

topics.headline: plural desire anticipates deified desire
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees a same-surah movement from plural social desires here to desire made a god in 45:23.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows give concrete same-surah recurrence; it illuminates the desire-field without changing the local plural object.

topics.headline: following desire as warning formula
topics.reader_payoff: The reader connects the local phrase to the wider Quranic warning where desire becomes dangerous when followed in place of knowledge-guidance.
topics.reason: The rows tie the noun field to following and knowledge, exactly the local structure of the prohibition.

topics.headline: plural desire swells then closes
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the plural desire-word expand and then stop, matching the unstable pull checked by the prohibition.
topics.reason: The sound rows concern the long vowel and final hamza of the local noun.

words.gloss_range: definite masculine plural relative pronoun attaching the desires to a group defined by lack of knowledge

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the desires whose owners are introduced by the relative pronoun

words.prose: {{ar:ٱلَّذِينَ}} ({{tr:alladhīna}}) keeps {{ar:أَهْوَآءَ}} ({{tr:ahwāʾa}}) from remaining abstract. It introduces the owners of those desires and makes them a defined group, with {{ar:لَا يَعْلَمُونَ}} ({{tr:lā yaʿlamūn}}) as the decisive predicate. The ayah therefore does not label the group by ethnicity or status; it diagnoses the guidance-system by lack of knowledge. The plural relative also continues the boundary chain from the prior plural failure after knowledge (45:17), and its liaison into the negated predicate makes that diagnosis sound tightly bound.

topics.headline: relative form defines a group
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the group is defined by the following predicate, not by a social label.
topics.reason: The definite plural relative opens the relative clause completed by the negated knowledge predicate.

topics.headline: desires tied to owners
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the prohibited object as socially and epistemically located, not as free-floating appetite.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks the relative pronoun as genitively attached to the desires and as subject of the final predicate.

topics.headline: plural group continues the boundary chain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can link the prior plural failure after knowledge to this plural group defined by not knowing.
topics.reason: The boundary row connects the plural groups across ayah 17 and ayah 18 while preserving the local shift in diagnosis.

topics.headline: relative bound to negation in sound
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the relative head and its negated predicate as tightly bound.
topics.reason: The sound row matches the syntactic bond between the relative pronoun and the following predicate.

words.prose: This second {{ar:لَا}} ({{tr:lā}}) is not another prohibition. Inside the relative clause, it negates {{ar:يَعْلَمُونَ}} ({{tr:yaʿlamūn}}) and turns {{ar:ٱلَّذِينَ}} ({{tr:alladhīna}}) into those defined by not knowing. Its echo with the earlier {{ar:لَا}} ({{tr:lā}}) moves the ayah from blocking desire-following to explaining why that desire-source fails.

topics.headline: negation defines the predicate
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that this negation diagnoses a group rather than issuing another command.
topics.reason: QAC marks this as a negative particle before the relative-clause predicate, not the prohibitive particle of word 10.

topics.headline: second negation explains the first
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears negation move from legal boundary to epistemic explanation.
topics.reason: The first negation governs the prohibition, while this second one negates the knowledge predicate that disqualifies the desire-owners.

words.gloss_range: objectless plural imperfect knowing verb, negated as an ongoing broad knowledge-defect
words.root_gloss_range: knowing, knowledge, teaching, informing, learning, and learnedness; the local Form I verb is negated and objectless, making absence of knowledge the closing criterion

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the plural relative subject agreed with by the verb

words.prose: {{ar:يَعْلَمُونَ}} ({{tr:yaʿlamūn}}) closes the ayah on knowledge's absence. The plural verb agrees with {{ar:ٱلَّذِينَ}} ({{tr:alladhīna}}) under {{ar:لَا}} ({{tr:lā}}), and no object is stated, so the defect is not narrowed to one missed fact. That broad, continuing unknowing disqualifies {{ar:أَهْوَآءَ}} ({{tr:ahwāʾa}}) as guidance and balances the earlier {{ar:ٱلْأَمْرِ}} ({{tr:al-ʾamri}}): true following requires a knowledge-grounded relation to command, not preference. The closing knowledge-field also answers the desire-without-guidance warning (28:50) and flips the previous ayah's knowledge-arrival into this final plural unknowing (45:17).

topics.headline: plural verb closes the relative clause
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the desire-owners gathered as a plural group at the ayah's close.
topics.reason: The verb is third masculine plural and attachment evidence links the relative pronoun as its subject.

topics.headline: objectless knowledge defect

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The placement construction at word 2, being upon a sharia at word 4, its source in the affair at word 6, and the paired following commands at words 7 and 9.
baseline_models.mechanism: The addressee is installed on an exposed, directed access course issuing from the affair. Following is therefore movement along an available line, while desires exert a rival pull away from it.

activation_trace.role: Transformation into a state makes the divine act an installation into a position rather than mere production.
An exposed entry to water supplies the course with material accessibility and a sustaining destination.
A directed extension or opening gives the accessible course an aimed orientation.
Affair as a state or concern makes the course arise from an encompassing order of things.
Going behind, obeying, and taking an exemplar supplies the actual locomotion along the course.
The soul's inclination supplies the competing attraction that can draw movement off-course.

changed_reading.before: The addressee is given a law and told to obey it rather than other people's desires.
changed_reading.after: The addressee is installed at a reachable, life-oriented course sourced in the affair and must travel its line instead of yielding to rival pulls.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The exact repetition of the following root in the imperative and prohibition, the plural desires, and the closing denial of knowledge.
baseline_models.mechanism: The verse presents two kinetic trajectories rather than a static contrast of rules and feelings. One trajectory is directed and continuously traceable; the other accelerates, drops, and lacks reliable waymarks.

activation_trace.role: Directed projection supplies a stable heading for the positive trajectory.
Following behind makes both the command and prohibition choices of whom or what will lead.
Unbroken succession turns following into a continuing trajectory rather than a single assent.
Falling toward a depth gives the rival trajectory a downward consequence.
Rapid rushing supplies the rival trajectory's impulsive speed and weakens deliberative control.
A distinguishing waymark makes knowledge operational orientation rather than stored information.

changed_reading.before: The verse contrasts obedience with subjective preference.
changed_reading.after: The verse requires a continuing choice of trajectory: track the marked heading, or be swept into a fast but unmarked descent.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Being placed upon a course from the affair, followed by a command not to follow the plural desires of an unknowing group.
baseline_models.mechanism: The placement can be read as delegated public judgment. The affair supplies authority and deliberation, the course supplies an undertaking, and the prohibited desires become factional opinions that would capture that judgment.

activation_trace.role: Installation into a rank or condition supports delegated position rather than private possession.
Authority and office supply the public jurisdiction from which the course proceeds.
Consultation and managed opinion supply the judgment process that desire can distort.
Entering an undertaking makes the course an enacted responsibility.
Obedient following identifies which authority governs the undertaking.
Mutually reinforced contentious inclination turns plural desires into rival programs of judgment.
Disclosure to a knower sets the epistemic qualification missing from rival counsel.

changed_reading.before: The instruction is chiefly about personal fidelity.
changed_reading.after: The instruction also protects delegated judgment from capture by mutually reinforcing, epistemically unqualified factions.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sharia object, the demand to follow, the prohibition using the same following root, and the contrast with unknowing desires.
baseline_models.mechanism: The course can be heard as sufficient to reach its end, while every chosen following carries a consequence that adheres to the follower. Its adequacy contrasts with hollow desire and makes conduct, not rule accumulation, decisive.

activation_trace.role: Sufficiency that reaches an objective makes the course adequate rather than merely extensive.
Binding demand converts adequacy into an obligation to enact the course.
An adhering liability makes each act of following carry its own claim or consequence.
Fit and coherence make faithful following an integrated practice rather than a loose inventory.
Emptiness and lack of inner stability provide the negative image of an inadequate guide.

changed_reading.before: Sharia is an external inventory whose value lies in comprehensiveness.
changed_reading.after: Sharia is an adequate, coherent practice that reaches its end, and whichever line one follows brings an attached consequence.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening descent, book, and wisdom sequence turns the focus placement into reception of a delivered, binding, corrective course. The route image remains live, but it now carries textual and restraining force.

activation_trace.role: A directed opening remains the focus course whose authority the context sharpens.
Demand and obligation anchor the delivered course in binding address.
Obedient following is the recipient's enacted response to delivery.
Caused descent as conveyance supplies the source-to-recipient delivery of the course.
A fixed record that obligates or determines supplies binding persistence to what is delivered.
Restraint that turns back disorder for repair makes the course corrective rather than merely informative.

structural_cues: 45:2 places descent, book, might, and wisdom before the sequence of signs and responses.
45:6 later presents continuing recitation upon an addressee, preserving an ongoing reception structure.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies delivery, binding record, corrective restraint, and the focus placement; I infer that delivery authorizes the course. A live alternative is that these establish only the wider discourse while sharia remains primarily a traversable route.

changed_reading.before: The course is available and authoritative, but its mode of arrival is unspecified.
changed_reading.after: The course is a delivered and durable address whose authority includes restraint and repair.

context_deltas.mechanism: Rain is delivered, dead earth is revived, winds are turned, and a vessel flows through the sea by the affair. These sequences literalize the focus water-access branch and recast sharia as a channel that makes life and purposeful motion possible.

activation_trace.role: The accessible water-entry branch supplies the focus model's channel and destination.
Following supplies responsive movement through the channel.
Delivered descent supplies water to the lower field rather than leaving provision remote.
Earth coming alive through water supplies the channel's life-bearing effect.
Turning from state to state supplies controlled redirection rather than random drift.
Flowing and coursing supply the motion enabled by a prepared medium.
A vessel circulating through water supplies the traveler carried by the ordered channel.
The affair as governing condition explicitly joins enabled flow to the focus course's source.

structural_cues: 45:5 orders descent, revival, and wind-turning as a causal material sequence.
45:12 places sea, vessel, flow, and the affair in one enabling construction.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies water delivery, revival, controlled turning, and vessel-flow by the affair; I infer that the focus course channels rather than merely commands life-bearing motion. The live alternative is a looser ecological analogy with no causal claim about sharia itself.

changed_reading.before: The watercourse branch is a lexical backdrop for an accessible legal path.
changed_reading.after: The course behaves like an ordered current: it brings access to life, carries purposeful action, and must be entered and followed.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surrounding sequence distinguishes exposure from responsive knowledge: one hears yet persists, knows something yet mocks, communities diverge after knowledge through rivalry, and desire can be installed as an object of devotion upon knowledge. The focus denial of knowledge therefore names failed alignment with disclosed marks, not necessarily absence of data.

activation_trace.role: Disclosure to a knower anchors the question of what kind of knowing is denied.
A discriminating mark makes knowledge visible as usable orientation.
Inclination supplies the motive that can override disclosed orientation.
Following turns knowledge into practiced alignment and exposes refusal when conduct points elsewhere.
Hearing as understanding and compliance supplies the response that persistence pointedly withholds.
Firm persistence supplies an active resistance after exposure.
Actual acquisition of some knowledge blocks a simple no-information explanation.
Taking mutually different roads supplies communal divergence despite disclosure.
Transgressive rivalry supplies the motive that converts knowledge into faction.
Disclosed knowledge temporally precedes the rivalry and therefore cannot be reduced to ignorance of facts.
Inclination elevated into devotion shows desire reorganizing allegiance rather than merely tempting it.
A secured blocking seal supplies the endpoint of repeatedly refused orientation.

structural_cues: 45:8 moves from hearing to persistence as though no hearing occurred, and 45:9 then grants partial knowing before mockery.
45:17 explicitly orders knowledge before rivalry-driven divergence; 45:23 juxtaposes desire and knowledge in one subject.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies exposure, persistence, knowledge-before-rivalry, desire, and sealing; I infer the arrow from repeated refusal to practical unknowing. Limited comprehension remains a live alternative, so the model does not make every instance of ignorance fully deliberate.

changed_reading.before: Those prohibited as leaders simply lack relevant information.
changed_reading.after: They lack knowledge as governing orientation: signs may have reached them, but persistence, rivalry, and desire prevent those signs from directing practice.

context_deltas.mechanism: Recompense, acquisition, deliberate action, the self, and return activate the focus branch of adhering consequence. Following the course is not group identification alone; it is practice whose benefit or harm returns to the practitioner.

activation_trace.role: Entry into an undertaking makes the course a practiced commitment.
An adhering claim or liability supplies the consequence carried by either following choice.
Obligation makes the consequential practice answerable rather than optional.
Action met by corresponding return supplies the mechanism of consequence.
Seeking and acquiring a result makes consequence something accumulated through conduct.
Purposive action supplies the concrete unit by which a followed course is enacted.
The self as the very entity concerned identifies the bearer of benefit and harm.
Return to a prior source closes the consequence loop around the actor.

structural_cues: 45:14 links communal action to recompense, and 45:15 assigns good and bad action back to the same self before return.
The focus repeats the same following verb on both sides of the prohibition, allowing both choices to carry consequences.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies acquired action, self-directed benefit or harm, return, and the focus consequence branch; I infer that following generates the adhering consequence. The alternative is a later judgment relation that does not define sharia's immediate operation.

changed_reading.before: Following marks allegiance to the correct norm.
changed_reading.after: Following enacts a course whose consequences adhere to and return upon the follower, whichever leader is chosen.

context_deltas.mechanism: A prior community receives book and judgment, then divides into different roads after clear knowledge through rivalry. The focus 'then' placement reads as a successor commission: preserve and enact a common course from the same affair without reproducing factional capture.

activation_trace.role: Installation into a position supplies the successor commission.
Entry into an undertaking makes succession an enacted custodial task.
Continuous succession gives the new commission temporal continuity with what precedes it.
Mutual contentious inclination supplies the factional pressure the commission must resist.
A binding written determination supplies the inherited institutional charge.
Judgment between people supplies the public dimension of the prior charge.
The same affair-as-concern directly links the prior disclosures to the focus course's source.
Disclosure by statement or mark supplies clarity before the fracture.
Different parties taking different roads supplies the institutional fracture.
Transgressive rivalry supplies the social cause of fracture.
Decisive judgment supplies the unresolved endpoint beyond present factional claims.

structural_cues: 45:16-17 immediately precede the focus and move from inherited institutions to rivalry-driven division.
The focus opens with a temporal successor marker and shifts from a plural community to a singular commissioned addressee.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies prior institutions, fracture after clarity, rivalry, and then a singular placement; I infer a remedial successor commission. The live alternative is simple contrast with the prior community rather than institutional continuity.

changed_reading.before: The focus begins an independent instruction to follow a revealed law.
changed_reading.after: The focus commissions a successor to carry a shared affair forward without repeating the factional divergence that followed earlier knowledge.

context_deltas.mechanism: The people whose desires are not to be followed appear as mutually supporting parts of an alliance, contrasted with divine guardianship of the protected. Following desire can therefore reroute jurisdiction, intimacy, and protection into a social patronage network.

activation_trace.role: Office and authority make the object of following a question of jurisdiction.
Following an exemplar supplies the transfer of practical allegiance.
Reciprocal contentious desire supplies the affect binding the rival network.
Parts partitioned from a whole supply the network's many mutually referring members.
Proximity without an intervening gap supplies the network's binding closeness.
Affection, support, and alliance supply the network's protective exchange.
Repelling harm through protection supplies the contrasting guardianship outside that network.

structural_cues: 45:19 immediately resumes the focus group with a statement that they cannot avail the addressee.
The verse balances mutual human alliance against a different singular guardianship.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies plural desires, mutual alliance, authority, and contrasting protection; I infer that following transfers social and jurisdictional alignment. A live alternative keeps the alliance statement eschatological and separate from the focus prohibition.

changed_reading.before: The danger is adopting other people's private preferences.
changed_reading.after: The danger is entering a mutually reinforcing patronage order whose desires, authority, and promised protection compete with the commissioned course.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus course's equality branch is checked by the later rejection of making unlike practitioners simply equal. The course instead aligns acquired action, judgment, and outcome, preventing the injustice of putting unlike cases in the same place.

activation_trace.role: Equality and matching supply a live but contextually constrained dimension of the course.
Putting persons into a condition supplies the act whose fairness depends on proper differentiation.
Acquiring deeds through one's own agency supplies the differentiating input.
Equating two things supplies the flat sameness the rhetorical question rejects.
Judgment between people identifies the evaluative act condemned when it erases relevant difference.
Corresponding recompense supplies proportional matching in place of flat sameness.
Acquired result supplies the conduct to which the outcome is matched.
Putting something in the wrong place supplies the injustice avoided by calibrated judgment.

structural_cues: 45:21 frames indiscriminate equality as a bad judgment through a rhetorical question.
45:22 immediately replaces sameness with correspondence between each self and what it acquired.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a focus equality branch, rejection of flat sameness, and action-corresponding recompense; I infer that sharia's equality is calibrated fit. The live alternative is that the focus equality branch is simply inactive here.

changed_reading.before: The course can be generalized as making people equal under one norm.
changed_reading.after: The course establishes equal measure without erasing morally relevant difference: judgment must fit outcomes to acquired action.

context_deltas.mechanism: Each way-bearing community is called to a register, and practiced acts are copied into a record that becomes a speaking sign. This activates following as trace-by-trace movement and attached liability: a followed course leaves an auditable path.

activation_trace.role: Following one trace after another supplies the sequence that can later be reconstructed.
An adhering liability makes the reconstructed trace answerable to its traveler.
A distinguishing mark makes each action legible as evidence of direction.
A gathered people or type supplies the collective bearer of a followed history.
A communal way supplies the path-shaped identity whose conduct is examined.
A vocal summons that draws its object supplies the call from lived path to account.
Enrollment in a register supplies the community-specific audit record.
Evidence that speaks by indication turns the accumulated trace into testimony.
Copying one written form into another supplies faithful preservation of the action sequence.
Purposive deeds supply the entries from which the path is reconstructed.

structural_cues: 45:28 moves from each community to its own book and recompense for what it practiced.
45:29 personifies the record as speaking and explains its relation to continuously copied action.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies communal ways, a call to records, copied actions, and evidentiary speech; I infer that following itself leaves the recordable trace. The live alternative is that the judgment record only evaluates actions without illuminating the semantics of following.

changed_reading.before: Following is obedience visible mainly at the moment of choice.
changed_reading.after: Following is cumulative path-making: successive acts leave marks that can be preserved, voiced, and attached to their traveler.

context_deltas.mechanism: Bad acts eventually appear and surround their agents, while worldly life deceives through an attractive but unstable signal. Desire is therefore not merely appetite; it operates as counterfeit guidance that invites adoption and hides the path's attached end until it becomes visible.

activation_trace.role: Inclination supplies the appetite that the counterfeit signs recruit.
A reliable distinguishing mark supplies the standard against which false signals fail.
Following makes successful deception consequential by converting appearance into a traveled line.
Emergence into visibility supplies the delayed disclosure of what the adopted path produced.
Descending harm that encloses its target supplies the path's previously hidden terminal environment.
Taking on a manner or pattern supplies the adoption induced by deceptive guidance.
An overt sign supplies the genuine signal that mockery displaces.
Deception by what flashes yet does not endure supplies the counterfeit signal's attraction.
Uncertainty and danger in the outcome supply what the attractive signal conceals.

strongest_changes: Sharia shifted from a static legal object to an accessible, delivered course that channels life-bearing and purposeful motion.
The closing denial of knowledge shifted from informational deficit to failed practical orientation after exposure, often driven by rivalry and desire.
Following became cumulative and accountable: it transfers allegiance, returns consequences to the actor, and leaves a recordable trace.
The immediate succession from prior communal fracture made the singular placement read as an anti-factional commission.
summary.what_was_special: The focus roots supported unusually coherent movement across hydraulic, navigational, institutional, social, and audit domains without forcing them into one final reading. The repeated positive and negative following verb kept every activation anchored as a choice of line, while split-root context material preserved stranger bearings such as the compass-and-whirlpool outlier.
remaining_uncertainties: The water-access and current model may be a strong material analogy rather than a governing sense of sharia in this construction.
Practical unknowing is strongly activated, but the text need not make every member of the prohibited group equally informed or deliberate.
The successor-commission reading depends on treating immediate temporal sequence as institutional continuity rather than contrast alone.
The sharpened-line, temporal-itinerary, and non-dominant د ر ي activations should remain explicitly exploratory.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **A visible access to sustaining command.** `ش ر ع/B002` is an accessible watering-place, and `ت ب ع/B001` is following a person, command, path, or trace. Coming after factional divergence, the packet places the addressee "upon" one access route and repeats follow/not-follow. I infer that command is figured as a public approach to sustaining water, not an abstract possession. The ayah reads as staying on an accessible life-bearing course while others' routes disperse.
2. **Desire as hollow guidance.** `ه و ي/B001` is air, void, and inward hollowness. The contrast is between a defined watering access and plural desires belonging to those without knowledge. I infer that desires imitate direction while lacking a stable object that can sustain the follower. The prohibition therefore contrasts a materially accessible course with trajectories organized around vacancy.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: Ayah 45:23 later makes desire into an adopted deity and pairs it with sealed faculties; the exploratory image of hollow guidance here becomes a full perceptual enclosure there.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **`شَرِيعَة` is a visible access to a sustaining source.** Lexical anchors: a visible watering access in `ش ر ع B002` and stepwise tracking in `ت ب ع B003`, under the ordinary following branch `ت ب ع B001`. The packet supplies integrated provision in 45:13, clarity turned into divergent paths in 45:17, and guidance/mercy in 45:20. I infer source -> opened access -> trackable route. The command reads as staying on a life-bearing channel through the matter, not merely conforming to an abstract rule-set.
2. **Desire supplies a rival gravity toward a hollow route.** Lexical anchors: desire/inclination in `ه و ي B004`, air/void in `ه و ي B001`, and falling into an abyss in `ه و ي B002`. The packet later makes the relation explicit in 45:23, where desire is taken as a deity and is followed by misguidance. I infer inclination treated as guide -> self-accelerating fall into an ungrounded course. The two `تَتَّبِعْ` forms now contrast a visible water-access with a path whose attractive force comes from its own void.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 45:23 made the dormant void of `ه و ي B001` and falling scope of `ه و ي B002` unavoidable by showing desire installed as a deity and followed by misguidance. That later ayah corrected "desires" from miscellaneous impulses into a rival guidance system.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Law Opens as a Watering Route
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A clear road brings travelers to an open water source; entering it and following its traces sustains directed movement.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: public approach to water (`quranic:root_000789:B002/m01`); entering and undertaking an affair (`quranic:root_000789:B003/m01`); following a person, order, or trace (`quranic:root_000175:B001/m01`); tracing an imprint step by step (`quranic:root_000175:B003/m01`); prophecy as a clear road (`quranic:root_001464:B007/m01`); gentle guidance to a path (`quranic:root_001583:B001/m01`); binding command (`quranic:root_000051:B002/m01`)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: `شريعة` supplies the setting and access point, prophecy supplies the road, command supplies direction, and following supplies locomotion. The legal image is therefore a maintained approach to life-giving access rather than an abstract rule set.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Desire Pulls the Follower Into a Hollow Fall
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A follower substitutes inward inclination for guidance; the directing medium proves hollow and becomes a downward trajectory into loss of the path.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: appetite and inward inclination (`quranic:root_001609:B004/m01`); empty air and an unsteady heart (`quranic:root_001609:B001/m01`); falling into an abyss (`quranic:root_001609:B002/m01`); following another's course (`quranic:root_000175:B001/m01`); straying from the intended road (`quranic:root_000913:B001/m01`); gentle guidance to the path (`quranic:root_001583:B001/m01`)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Desire is both the chosen guide and an empty space incapable of bearing weight. Following it thus changes from horizontal imitation into vertical descent, sharpening the contrast between a supplied route and self-directed appetite.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, kısa veya küçük hurma ağaçlarını topluluk olarak ve bunlardan birini tekil biçimde tanımlar. Geçici çerçeve hem boy hem küçüklük yönünü ve tekil ayrımını doğru korur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal yalnızca kısa veya küçük hurma ağaçlarına ilişkindir; yer adı, böcek ve genel bitki kısalığı anlamlarına uzanmaz.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: kısa veya küçük hurma ağaçları; tekili bu ağaçlardan biri

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, sıcak tencereyi ateşten veya onu taşıyan taşlardan indirirken kullanılan ve eli sıcaktan koruyan bezi açıkça tanımlar. Aynı tanıklık, tencereyi bu bezle indirme eylemini de ayrı bir türemiş kullanım olarak verir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal tencereyi indirmeye yarayan ısı koruyucu bez ve onunla yapılan eylemle sınırlıdır; ücret anlamındaki benzer biçim buna girmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Dal yalın ad ve ona bağlı eylem biçimlerini kapsar; başka dallardaki benzer sesli adlar tanıma alınmaz.

facets.statement: Sıcak tencereyi ocaktan indirirken tutmaya yarayan ve eli sıcaktan koruyan bezdir.

identity_judgment.boundary_note: Hayvanın kendisi yalın çekirdektir; suya ilişkin anlam yalnız bu hayvanların suda çok bulunmasını bildiren özel kuruluşta geçerlidir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, dişi köpeğin ve diğer yırtıcı dişilerin çiftleşmek üzere erkeği istemesini açıkça bildirir. Hem dişi köpekle kurulan söz öbeği hem de çekimli biçimler aynı üreme isteği durumuna bağlıdır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, Tanrı'nın kulları için belirlediği dinsel yol ve hükümleri açık yol ve yöntem imgesiyle birlikte verir; ayrıca bunları koyup görünür kılma eylemini belirtir. Sağlanan dal çerçevesi bu ortak çekirdeği doğru biçimde yansıtır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi silahı bir hedefe doğru uzatıp yöneltme ile bir kapı veya yolu geçişe açıp ileriye bağlama kullanımlarını açıkça toplar. Yön verilmiş uzanma çerçevesi bu iki yapıya bağlı gerçekleşmeyi doğru birleştirir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, yalnızca silah yöneltme ve kapı ya da yol açma yapılarıyla sınırlıdır; genel gönderme, dinsel düzen veya suya giriş değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, silahı hedefe yöneltme ile kapı veya yolu geçişe açma yapılarını korur ve bunları yalın bir uzatma anlamına dönüştürmez.

concept_map.definition: Bir mızrak ya da kılıcı hedefe doğru uzatıp yöneltmek veya bir kapı ya da yolu ileriye geçiş sağlayacak biçimde açmaktır.

facets.statement: Mızrakları ya da kılıçları belirli bir hedefe doğru uzatıp yöneltmektir.
Bir kapıyı yola açmak veya yolu ileriye geçecek biçimde açıp işler duruma getirmektir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar silahın hedefe uzatılıp yöneltilmesinde birleşir; kapı ve yolun ileriye açılması aynı yön verilmiş uzanmanın geçiş alanındaki kullanımını oluşturur.

concept_gloss.applicability: Silahın yöneltildiği ya da kapı ve yolun ileriye açıldığı sağlanan yapılarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Yöneltilmiş uzanmayı ve geçiş sağlayan açmayı birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Mızrak veya kılıcın bir kişi ya da topluluğa doğru uzatıldığı bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Silahın hedefe doğru uzatılması ve yöneltilmesini korur.
error_profile.loses: Kapı veya yolu geçişe açma kullanımını dışarıda bırakır.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kapı ya da yolun ileri yönde bağlantı sağlayacak biçimde açıldığı bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Kapı veya yolun ileriye açılıp geçiş sağlamasını korur.
error_profile.loses: Silahı hedefe doğru uzatma kullanımını dışarıda bırakır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Kapı veya yolu ileriye açma kullanımı da aynı dalın kapsamındadır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Mızraklarla hızlıca ilerleme ve onları süratle öne uzatma özellikle belirtilir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da mızrakları öne ve hedefe doğru uzatıp yöneltmeyi anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalı yöneltmeyi ve geçit açmayı kapsar; komşu dal mızrakların hızlı yöneltilmesi ve onlarla ilerlenmesiyle sınırlıdır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Silah hedefe uzatılıp yöneltilir; bırakılıp fırlatılması gerekmez.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Nesnenin elden, yaydan veya başka bir araçla gönderilip fırlatılması çekirdektir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal hedefe yönelik silah veya nesne hareketi alanındadır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalında silahın yönü ve uzatılmış duruşu belirleyicidir; komşu dalda nesnenin elden çıkıp hedefe gönderilmesi belirleyicidir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Uzatma belirli bir hedefe yönelmiştir veya ileriye geçiş açar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Nesnenin genel olarak yayılması, genişletilmesi ve yüzeye serilmesi bulunur.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da bir şeyin kapalı veya toplanmış durumdan uzatılmış duruma geçmesini paylaşır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalı hedef ve geçiş yönünü zorunlu kılar; komşu dal yön şartı olmadan genel yayılma ve genişlemeyi anlatır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar incelendi; hedefe yöneltmeyi hızlı mızrak ilerleyişinden, fırlatmadan ve genel yayılmadan ayıran üç karşılaştırma seçildi.
branches.what_is_ar: إشراع الرمح والسيوف وتوجيهها وفتح الباب أو الطريق إلى جهة نافذة
branches.what_is_not_ar: الشرع الديني ومورد الماء وسلخ الإهاب
branches.source_phrase_ar: أشرعت الرمح نحوه إشراعا؛ أشرعت طريقا إذا أنفذته وفتحته (maqayis)؛ أشرعت الرماح نحوهم إشراعا (ayn)؛ أشرعت بابا إلى الطريق؛ أشرعت الرمح قبله (sihah)؛ أشرعنا الرماح نحوهم؛ السيوف شرعن إليه (tahdhib)؛ أشرعت الرمح قبله (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi gergin telleri, yukarıda açılmış gemi yelkenini, kaldırılmış veya uzun boynu ve uzun mızrağı ortak bir uzanmışlık görünümü altında toplar. Sağlanan çerçeve bu biçimsel ortaklığı, nesneye göre değişen gerçekleşmeleri silmeden korur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, gerginlik, yukarı kaldırılma veya uzunluk taşıyan biçimlerle sınırlıdır; yol, dinsel düzen, su yeri ve deri yarma anlamlarını kapsamaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, tel ve yelken adlarını; boyun kaldırma, gemiye yelken takma ve uzunluk bildiren yapılardan ayrı tutar.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyin gergin biçimde uzanmış, yukarı kaldırılmış veya belirgin biçimde uzun olmasıdır. Teller ve yelken bu görünümün nesneleri; kaldırılmış boyun, uzun mızrak ve uzun boyunlu deve ise özel gerçekleşmeleridir.

facets.statement: Tellerin gerilmiş, yelkenin ise yukarıda açılıp uzanmış durumda olmasıdır.
Devenin boynunu yukarı kaldırıp uzatması biçiminde gerçekleşir.
Mızrağın veya deve boynunun belirgin uzunluğunu nitelemek için kullanılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar gergin teller, gemi yelkeni, kaldırılmış boyun ve uzun mızrak örneklerini uzanmış ve yükselmiş biçim çevresinde toplar; uzun boyunlu deve de bu nitelemenin özel örneğidir.

concept_gloss.text: gerilmiş, yükseltilmiş veya belirgin biçimde uzun
concept_gloss.applicability: Tel, yelken, boyun ve mızrakta görülen uzanmış biçimin ortak olarak anlatılması gerektiğinde kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Gerginlik, yukarı uzanma ve belirgin uzunluk gerçekleşmelerini birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Nesnenin tel ya da gemi yelkeni olduğu ad kullanımlarında tercih edilir.

error_profile.preserves: Gergin ve uzatılmış nesne görünümünü korur.
error_profile.loses: Boyun kaldırma ile mızrak ve boyun uzunluğunu kapsamaz.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Devenin boynunu yukarı kaldırdığı hareket bağlamında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Boynun yukarı kaldırılıp uzatılması hareketini korur.
error_profile.loses: Tel, yelken ve uzun mızrak gerçekleşmelerini dışarıda bırakır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Telleri, yelkeni ve uzun mızrağı da kapsayan daha geniş bir uzanmışlık alanı vardır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Boynun uzunluğu ile başın ve boynun kaldırılması kendi başına çekirdektir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal boynun uzun, kaldırılmış veya yukarı uzanmış görünümünde örtüşür.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalında boyun yalnızca tel, yelken ve mızrakla birlikte bir gerçekleşmedir; komşu dal doğrudan boyun uzunluğu ve baş kaldırma alanına bağlıdır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Boynun kaldırılması amaç belirtmeden uzanmış biçim olarak verilir ve başka nesnelere de yayılır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Baş veya boyun özellikle görmek, duymak ya da yukarıdan bakmak amacıyla uzatılır.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: uzanmış boyun ile bakmak için uzanma
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal başın kaldırılması ve boynun yukarı doğru uzatılması hareketinde birleşir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalı biçimi ve uzunluğu anlatır; komşu dal aynı hareketi algılama veya gözetleme amacıyla sınırlar.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Adayların tamamı değerlendirildi; boyun uzunluğu ve amaçlı boyun uzatma ile en öğretici iki sınır yayımlandı.

branches.source_phrase_ar: الشرع الأوتار؛ شراع السفينة؛ شرع البعير عنقه؛ رمح شراعي (maqayis)؛ الشرعة الوتر؛ الشراع شراع السفينة؛ رفع شراعه؛ رمح شراعي (sihah)؛ الشراع الأوتار؛ شراع السفينة؛ رفع شراعه؛ الشراعية الناقة الطويلة العنق (tahdhib)؛ شرعت السفينة جعلت لها شراعا؛ الشرع خص بما يشرع من الأوتار (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi deriyi bacakların arasından yarma ve ardından yüzme işlemlerini sıralı biçimde verir. Dal çerçevesi hem özgül kesim yerini hem de yüzme sonucunu koruduğu için kaynakla uyumludur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal yalnızca hayvan derisinin bacaklar arasından yarılıp yüzülmesi yapısına bağlıdır; genel yarma ya da yalnızca deriyi çıkarma anlamı değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, işlemi deri ile ve bacakların arasındaki özel yarma noktasına bağlı tutar.

concept_map.definition: Hayvan derisini bacaklarının arasından yararak açmak ve bu kesikten başlayıp deriyi gövdeden yüzmektir.

facets.statement: Deriyi önce bacakların arasından yarıp açmak, ardından bu açıklıktan başlayarak yüzmektir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, bacakların arasındaki özgül yarma işlemi ile derinin ardından yüzülmesini tek ve sıralı bir işlem olarak verir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Hayvan derisinin belirtilen noktadan açılıp ardından çıkarıldığı işlem için kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Özgül yarma yerini, işlem sırasını ve derinin yüzülmesini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Kesme ile yüzme aşamalarının doğal bir cümlede birlikte anlatıldığı bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Kesim yerini ve ardından gelen deri yüzme işlemini eksiksiz korur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Yüzme işlemi bacakların arasındaki belirli bir yarıkla başlar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Deri, kesimin yeri belirtilmeden hayvanın veya belirli bölümlerinin üzerinden genel olarak çıkarılır.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: özel kesikle yüzme ile genel deri çıkarma
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal kesilmiş bir hayvanın derisini gövdeden ayırıp çıkarma işlemini anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalı bacaklar arasındaki ilk yarığı kurucu koşul yapar; komşu dal genel deri çıkarma işlemidir ve bu başlangıç yerini gerektirmez.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Belirli yerden yarılan şey deridir ve yarma işlemini deri yüzme izler.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Karın veya başka bir şey genel olarak yarılır, açılır ya da genişletilir.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: deriyi yarıp yüzme ile genel yarıp açma
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal bir yüzeyi keserek açıklık oluşturma işlemini paylaşır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalında kesik, deriyi yüzmenin ilk aşamasıdır; komşu dalda yarıp açma kendi başına tamamlanmış işlemdir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bacaklar arasından yarılan deri daha sonra bütünüyle yüzülür.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Kulağın biri veya ikisi iki parçaya ayrılacak biçimde yarılır.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: deri yüzme kesiği ile kulak yarığı
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal hayvan bedenine bağlı bir dokunun yarılarak açılması alanındadır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalındaki yarık deri yüzmeye araçtır; komşu dalda kulağın yarılması işlemin kendisi ve kalıcı sonucudur.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Tüm komşular incelendi; özgül kesim ve yüzme dizisini genel deri çıkarmadan, genel açmadan ve kulak yarmadan ayıran üçü seçildi.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi iki şeyin birbirinin benzeri olması ile kişilerin belirli bir işte eşit durumda bulunmasını aynı yapıya bağlı olarak verir. Sağlanan eşitlik ve benzerlik çerçevesi bu iki yakın görünümü doğru kapsar.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, sağlanan benzetme ve eşitlik ifadeleriyle sınırlıdır; yeterlilik, dinsel düzen veya su yeri anlamlarını taşımaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, benzerlik ve eşitliği yalnızca sağlanan karşılaştırma yapılarında verir ve yalın köke genellemez.

concept_map.definition: İki şeyin birbirinin benzeri ya da dengi olması veya birden çok kişinin belirli bir iş bakımından aynı durumda bulunmasıdır.

facets.statement: İki şeyin birbirine benzer veya denk olmasıdır.
Birden çok kişinin belirli bir iş veya durum bakımından eşit olmasıdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, iki şey arasındaki benzerlik ve denklik ile bir topluluğun aynı işte eşit durumda bulunmasını ortak anlam olarak verir.

concept_gloss.applicability: İki şeyin denkliği ya da kişilerin belli bir işte eşitliği anlatıldığında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Benzerlik, denklik ve belirli bir durumdaki eşitliği birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir nesne veya kişinin başka birine benzer ve denk olduğu karşılaştırmalarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: İki tekil öğe arasındaki benzerlik ve denklik ilişkisini korur.
error_profile.loses: Bir topluluğun belirli bir işte eşit durumda olmasını doğrudan anlatmaz.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Birden çok kişinin aynı konu bakımından eşit sayıldığı bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Belirli bir işteki ortak ve eşit durumu korur.
error_profile.loses: İki şey arasındaki genel benzerlik ilişkisini geri plana iter.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Benzerlik ve eşitlik sağlanan kalıplaşmış karşılaştırma ifadelerine bağlıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Şeyler veya kişiler arasında genel eşitleme, dengeleme ve karşılıklı ölçme alanı vardır.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: kalıba bağlı denklik ile genel eşitleme
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal iki şey veya kişi arasındaki benzerlik, denklik ve eşitliği anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Anlam çekirdekleri yakın olsa da odak dalı belirli söyleyiş kalıplarıyla sınırlıdır; komşu dal eşitleme ve dengeleme ilişkisini genel olarak kapsar.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Benzer ya da eşit olma belirli ad cümlesi ve iş bakımından eşitlik yapılarında kurulur.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Miktar, değer veya fiyat bakımından eşitlenme ve karşılıklı değer taşıma da kapsama girer.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: kalıba bağlı eşitlik ile ölçüsel eşitlik
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal birden çok öğenin eşit, denk veya aynı düzeyde olmasını paylaşır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalı sağlanan karşılaştırma yapılarındaki benzerliği anlatır; komşu dal ölçü, miktar ve değer bakımından eşitliği de içerir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Kişilerin aynı işte eşit durumda oluşu da anlamın parçasıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Bir şeyin başka bir şeye özellikle karşılık ve örnek olarak denk konması öne çıkar.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: eşit durumda olma ile karşılık olarak denk koyma
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal benzer, denk ve birbirine karşılık sayılan öğeleri anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalı hem benzerliği hem ortak durumdaki eşitliği taşır; komşu dal karşılıklı denk ve örnek olma ilişkisini merkez alır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Adayların tümü değerlendirildi; kalıba bağlı eşitliği genel eşitleme, ölçüsel denklik ve karşılık olarak denk koymadan ayıran üçü yayımlandı.

branches.source_phrase_ar: هذه شرعة ذاك أي مثله (ayn)؛ هذه شرعة هذه؛ هذا شرع هذا؛ هما شرعان أي مثلان (sihah)؛ هم في الأمر شرع أي سواء؛ هذا شرعة ذاك أي مثله (tahdhib)؛ هم في هذا الأمر شرع أي سواء (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bir şeyin yeterli olduğunu söyleyen kalıbı ve kişinin ulaştığı miktarla yetinmesini açıkça bildirir. Sağlanan yeterlilik çerçevesi hem yeterli ölçüyü hem de daha fazlasına gerek kalmaması sonucunu korur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal yalnızca yeterlilik bildiren sağlanan yapılarla sınırlıdır; benzerlik, eşitlik veya dinsel düzen anlamı taşımaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, yeterlilik anlamını sağlanan hitap ve miktar yapıları içinde tutar; yalın kök anlamı saymaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyin kişi için yeterli olması veya kişinin ulaştığı miktarın amacına yetip daha fazlasına ihtiyaç bırakmamasıdır.

facets.statement: Belirtilen şeyin kişi için yeterli ve ihtiyacı karşılayacak ölçüde olmasıdır.
Kişinin ulaşabildiği miktarla yetinip daha fazlasını aramamasını bildirir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, belirtilen şeyin yeterli gelmesi ve ulaşılan miktarın ihtiyaç için kafi sayılması üzerinde birleşir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bir şeyin ihtiyacı karşıladığı veya ulaşılan miktarın yeterli sayıldığı yapılarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Yeterlilik ölçüsünü ve ulaşılanla yetinme sonucunu birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Belirli bir şeyin kişi için yeterli olduğu doğrudan söylendiğinde kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Belirtilen şeyin ihtiyacı karşılayacak kadar oluşunu korur.
error_profile.loses: Ulaşılan miktarla yetinme biçimindeki genişletilmiş kullanımı söylemez.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Kişinin elde ettiği veya eriştiği miktarı yeterli sayması istendiğinde kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Ulaşılan miktarın yeterli görülmesi ve onunla yetinme yönünü korur.
error_profile.loses: Tek bir nesnenin doğrudan yeterli ilan edilmesini kapsamaz.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Ulaşılan miktarla yetinme söyleyişi de sağlanan yapının parçasıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Bir kişi veya şeyin genel olarak yeterli ve kafi olduğunu söyleyen daha geniş ifade alanı vardır.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: kalıba bağlı yeterlilik ile genel yeterlik bildirimi
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal bir şeyin kişi için yeterli olduğunu doğrudan söyleme anlamında büyük ölçüde örtüşür.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalı belirli hitap ve ulaşılan miktar kalıplarıyla sınırlıdır; komşu dal aynı yeterlik yargısını daha genel söyleyişlerle kurar.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi genel yakınlık ve üzerine uzanıp görünme durumunu; yola yakın ev, batışa yaklaşmış yıldız ve başları görünür balık örnekleriyle verir. Sağlanan darlık ve üzerinden görünme çerçevesi kullanılabilir, ancak balık örneği yalnızca yakınlık değil başın su üstünde belirginleşmesini de gerektirir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, yakın durma ile öne veya yukarı uzanıp görünür olmayı kapsar; örneklerin her birini yalnızca fiziksel mesafe yakınlığına indirgemez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, genel yakın ve üzerine uzanır olma biçimini; balık, yıldız ve evle sınırlı yapılardan ayrı gösterir.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyin başka bir şeye yakın durması veya ona doğru uzanıp belirgin ve görünür durumda bulunmasıdır. Balığın başını su üstünde göstermesi, yıldızın batışa yaklaşması ve evin yola yakın olması bu durumun ayrı örnekleridir.

facets.statement: Bir şeye yakın duran veya onun üzerine doğru uzanıp belirginleşen durumda olmaktır.
Balıkların başlarını su üstünde belirgin biçimde göstermesi bu görünümün canlılara bağlı örneğidir.
Yıldızların batışa yaklaşmış olması yakınlık yönünün göğe bağlı örneğidir.
Bir evin yola ve insanlara yakın, yola bakar durumda olması mekansal örnektir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar yakın durma ve üzerine doğru uzanıp görünür olma çekirdeğini; su üstünde beliren balıklar, batışa yaklaşan yıldızlar ve yola yakın ev üzerinden somutlaştırır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bu dalı yasaklamanın karşıtı olan yapma isteği, yükümlü kılma ve bu isteğin söz kalıbı olarak tanımlar. Geçici çerçeve çıplak ve yapı içi kullanımları birlikte tutar, fakat anlamı genel konuya veya yöneticiliğe genişletmez.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bu dalı yaratma ve var etme anlamına bağlar ve bunu Tanrı'ya özgü tutar; ayrıca var edici sözle hızla gerçekleşme örneği verir. Geçici çerçeve doğrudur, fakat tanımın insanın başkasına buyruğuna genellenmemesi gerekir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Yalnız Tanrı'ya özgü var etme anlamıdır; insan buyruğu, makam veya genel konu anlamı değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Mekanik tür bare olsa da kaynak sınırlaması gereği tanım çıplak biçimi yalnız ilahi yaratma alanında tutar.

facets.statement: Çekirdek anlam, var etme ve yaratmadır.
Bu yaratma insanlara değil, Tanrı'ya özgü olarak sınırlandırılır.
Yaratıcı sözle varlığın hemen gerçekleşmesi bu anlamın örnek anlatımıdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Bu dal için ortak çoklu kaynak özeti yoktur; tanıklık tek kaynak ayrıntısında ilahi yaratma ve var edici söz örneğiyle verilir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, bir kimsenin yanında ya da arkasında gitmeyi, onun izini sürmeyi ve ayrıca bir buyruğa, örneğe veya öğretiye uymayı aynı temel izleme ilişkisi altında toplar. Verilen dal çerçevesi bu bedensel ve davranışsal yönleri doğru biçimde yansıtır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal, geride kalmış birine yetişmeyi, adım adım araştırmayı ve bir hakkı istemeyi içermez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Dal yalın kullanımı kapsar; tanım, özel bir söz öbeğine bağlı olmayan fiziksel izleme ve örnek ya da buyruğa uyma anlamlarıyla sınırlıdır.

concept_map.definition: Bir kişi, topluluk, iz, buyruk veya örneğin ardından gitmek; bunu bedensel olarak arkasından ilerleyerek ya da davranışını ve yönlendirmesini benimseyerek yapmak.

facets.statement: Bir kişiyle birlikte ya da onun arkasında ilerleyerek ardından gitmek.
Bir iz, örnek, buyruk veya öğreti doğrultusunda davranmak ve ona uymak.
Ardından giden kişiyi ya da kişileri tekil veya toplu olarak adlandırmak.

concept_gloss.applicability: Hem birinin fiziksel olarak ardından ilerlemesini hem de onun buyruğunu, örneğini veya yolunu benimsemeyi kapsayan genel karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Bedensel izleme ile davranışsal uyma arasındaki ortak ardından gitme ilişkisini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişi veya topluluğun yanında ya da arkasında fiziksel olarak ilerleme bağlamında kullanılır.
